proposed_unexecuted.title: Missing, unsupported, malformed, and supported input discriminator
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Use four distinct cases: nonexistent path; valid OJPEG TIFF; malformed TIFF bytes; known supported tiled TIFF. Verify the OJPEG fixture is structurally a TIFF and carries the OJPEG compression tag before import. Run through the application import service, not a library-only helper.
proposed_unexecuted.expected: MissingInput; UnsupportedFeature(OJPEG); MalformedInput; and successful supported import respectively. The first three leave the existing project generation and original bytes unchanged. Preserve reason and progress/cancel state in each error record.
proposed_unexecuted.limits: No OJPEG fixture or app implementation is supplied here. tifffile documentation justifies the feature boundary, not the expected exception type or full app behavior.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Reader support matrix on pinned package and lab fixtures
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Pin the selected tifffile/imagecodecs/Zarr dependencies; run metadata-only and bounded-region reads against representative lab TIFF/OME-TIFF files and known NDPI/BIF examples. Test a separate BIF stitching expectation. Record file identities, source dimensions/axes, calibration and operation outcome.
proposed_unexecuted.expected: Only explicitly admitted combinations import. NDPI/BIF library capabilities are not confused with app v1 inclusion; BIF stitching is reported unavailable until separately implemented.
proposed_unexecuted.limits: The public README is not a guarantee for local vendor variants. No lab files or package installs/runs were available in this Goal.

proposed_unexecuted.title: 3 GB bounded access, progress, and cancellation
proposed_unexecuted.plan: On the 8-core/16 GB target, read viewport tiles from a 3 GB representative source under cold and warm cache; measure p95 tile latency, peak RSS, bytes decoded, cancel latency, and UI responsiveness.
proposed_unexecuted.expected: No second full source-sized resident copy; progress advances and cancellation stops queued work. Proposed starting thresholds: p95 below 100 ms, peak RSS below 4 GB, cancellation below 250 ms.
proposed_unexecuted.limits: Thresholds are proposed engineering acceptance values, not measured facts. Requires real source files and app/runtime implementation.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Coordinate, calibration, and export round trip
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Use asymmetric x/y/z scales, nonzero origin, one orientation change, and a point/polygon on an identified plane/time. Export a table and small raster with manifest; re-import the table and compare pixel/world coordinates and source hash.
proposed_unexecuted.expected: Named axes and declared center/origin convention reproduce stored binary64 coordinates; applied operations and omitted metadata appear in the manifest; display-only window/level changes source hash not at all and do not alter sample bytes.
proposed_unexecuted.limits: Arithmetic fixture does not establish behavior until run through actual importer, annotation editor, and exporter. No execution receipt exists.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Interrupted save/export and shared-storage recovery
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Interrupt writes before and after generation publication, validate reopen from previous/current generation, then repeat on the lab's actual SMB/NFS share and across a mount boundary.
proposed_unexecuted.expected: Only a validated generation is authoritative; previous good project remains readable; partial export is not mistaken for complete; recovery report names orphan files and hash state.
proposed_unexecuted.limits: Local rename behavior does not establish NFS/SMB durability; system and filesystem-specific tests required.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Instrument calibration regression fixtures across reader upgrades
proposed_unexecuted.plan: For each instrument, pin a small representative image plus expected native metadata/value-unit pairs. Run the same assertions through the workspace import adapter before approving any reader version update.
proposed_unexecuted.expected: Any changed unit or value fails loudly or requires a recorded correction. Include a TVIPS-style regression test modeled on the tifffile #319 test structure.
proposed_unexecuted.limits: The upstream issue test uses a private fixture; this plan requires lab-owned or otherwise legally reusable fixtures. It does not assert the upstream suite was rerun.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Cross-workstation reopen and source relocation
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Move a reference project to a second workstation/path and separately move a portable copy. Verify resolver behavior, hash mismatch handling, annotations, metadata, and view state.
proposed_unexecuted.expected: Portable copies open by project-relative location; reference paths prompt for resolution; changed source hash never silently rebinds existing annotations.
proposed_unexecuted.limits: Requires two machines or equivalent filesystem/path environments; not proven by project JSON structure documentation.
